properties.description: tools/test_content_policy.py drives the real reflow2-mcp binary over stdio under four client names and the operator flag: claude-code gets the signpost and structuredContent; grok-shell-reflow2 gets the payload as JSON in the text block equal to structuredContent, with no flag; opencode gets an empty text block with structuredContent kept; an unknown client under --content-policy duplicate gets the payload, and grok under --content-policy signpost is overridden back; a prose tool and a refusal reach grok untouched. Unit tests in content_policy.rs cover the reshaping itself (duplicate, empty, only-the-signpost-shape, flag parsing, name keying). Wired into CI's full job.
properties.findings: 9 of 9 wire checks pass against the 2026-09-15 debug build; 5 of 5 unit tests pass.
properties.name: The content block is keyed on the handshake name, on the wire
